gestures.label: menu
gestures.how: Hold BOOT, then also hold PWR. Keep both held until PWR registers a long press (about 1.5s): that opens the app menu. Do the same chord again to close it and return to what was running.

stack.source: Pico SDK default (PICO_CORE0_STACK_SIZE / PICO_CORE1_STACK_SIZE, 0x800 each): firmware/CMakeLists.txt sets no override, and the SDK itself is fetched externally by firmware/pico_sdk_import.cmake rather than vendored in this repository, so this is the SDK's own documented default, not a value read out of a linker script that lives here. See tools/stack-usage.ts's header comment for what it checks this against and what it does not (a single function's frame, not a call-graph total).
